text:
lina: Quick oddball from on-prem QA: samplekit JS in json_mode is flaking when an auth refresh triggers a stream retry. Validator throws on final assemble.

ash: can you sketch a tiny repro?

lina: steps: 1) kick off /generate with `json_mode: true` + streaming tool that emits array items, 2) expire token mid-stream, 3) SDK refreshes and retries the tail. Resulting buffer looks like `...][...` and JSON.parse bombs.

lina: log paste:
```
INFO chunk 5: "\n]"
INFO auth: token expired, refreshing
INFO stream retry initiated
INFO chunk 6 (replay): "[\n{\"x\":1}\n"
ERROR schema-validator: Unexpected token ']' at position 1
```

chloe: sounds like the stitcher never resets when a retry happens and just concatenates. That's brittle.

tom: current stitcher code: `buffer += chunk; if (isBoundary(chunk)) tryParse(buffer)` - no replay detection.

ash: remediation ideas: (A) short-term: be forgiving in parser for stray `[`/`]` around JSON mode, trimming separators before parse, (B) mid-term: add `x-stream-session` header so retries are identifiable and stitcher can reset, (C) long-term: switch to length-prefixed framing for structured streams.

lina: i prefer session ids + clear retry eventing in logs. Users and tests can then detect replay vs. resume.

chloe: i'll add a unit test in sdk-js that simulates a replayed prefix and ensure final assembled array equals the concatenation of items, not two separate arrays.

tom: i'll prototype stitcher change: if `x-stream-retry: true` is present, reset buffer before consuming chunks; also add defensive trimming of empty separators when json_mode=true.

ash: also audit sdk-py and sdk-ts for the same naive stitcher. parity likely.

retry-bot: created issue #4862: "stream-retry + json_mode -> stitcher concat bug" (assignees: tom, chloe)

lina: attaching QA session and sample logs to #4862. Thanks everyone.
